entries.16df1eb87f098514: The company purchases completed custom-made wigs from its manufacturing subsidiaries and delivers them to customers through 283 locations in Japan. Female ready-made wigs are sold through 91 Julia Ōjē stores and 36 stores of NAO-ART Co. It acquires new customers through response sales based on advertising responses and works to convert them into repeat orders through after-sales service.
entries.1def7bcdc724d8f6: The group consists of the company and 12 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026) and is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. Consolidated employees number 3,851.
entries.1dfb8dee72980ce3: This is the core business of the group, which consists of the Company and 12 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026), and its main activity is the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. The reportable segments are three, which divide hair-related products and services for general customers by customer gender: the "Men's Business," the "Women's Business" and the "Women's Ready-Made Products Business." For custom-made wigs, after the shape of the head is measured at a store with a 3D molding system, manufacturing is outsourced to a manufacturing subsidiary, and the Company purchases the finished products and delivers them through 283 stores in Japan.
entries.299b52246d89507a: After measuring the shape of customers’ heads with a 3D molding system in stores, the company outsources manufacturing of its main custom-made wigs to 2 manufacturing subsidiaries in the Philippines (AN Philippines Co. and ANMP Co.). A new factory of ANBD Co., set up in Bangladesh as a production dispersal base, began operations from the fiscal year ended March 2026. The company purchases its main raw materials, human hair and artificial hair, in bulk and supplies them free of charge to the manufacturing subsidiaries.
entries.3e02067c5ea59737: Consideration for other products and services provided
entries.3e7d73f53807feb7: This business provides ready-made wigs, other products and services to female customers. The ready-made wigs are manufactured by the group's manufacturing subsidiaries and by contract manufacturers outside the group in Asian countries, and are sold at 91 stores of a separate store format, "Julia Orrège," and 36 stores of NAO-ART. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,227 million.
entries.4e903a0a12ffe36e: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥44,600 million, up 2.9% from the previous year.

entries.faab44c85cd5e40f: Its management philosophy is to provide the highest quality and best service suited to all customers with hair concerns as a comprehensive hair company, advocating ‘a more positive way of living and a more beautiful, radiant lifestyle’ and aiming to ‘create a hair culture that satisfies customers.’ The medium-term management plan ‘ARTNATURE Frontier Plan,’ with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its first year, aims to ‘strengthen the business foundation and take on challenges in new fields’ under its long-term vision ‘Aiming to become the world’s leading wig life maker.’ It focuses on 5 issues: strengthening the customer base, strengthening the production base, improving efficiency, challenging new fields and considering overseas expansion, and strengthening human capital.
